version.changelog: v3.0.0: 修复记忆系统触发机制，更新描述

llm.summary: The skill's requested file reads/writes and session access are consistent with its stated purpose of extracting and persisting conversational ‘memories’; there are no unexpected credentials, installs, or instruction-scope surprises.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the instructions: the skill analyzes conversation endings and writes memory/topic files and an index. Required permissions (FileRead/FileWrite/sessions_history) are appropriate for this purpose and nothing unrelated (no cloud creds, no external services) is requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines behavior to reading recent conversation messages, creating/updating files under memory/ (topics/, MEMORY.md, heartbeat-state.json), and invoking on explicit triggers/heartbeat — all consistent with extracting memories. It does not instruct reading unrelated system files or exfiltrating data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. No downloads, packages, or binaries are requested, minimizing install-time risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths outside the memory/ workspace are required. The declared permissions (FileRead/FileWrite/sessions_history) are proportional to the documented behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill persists data to memory/topics and MEMORY.md as expected for a memory extraction tool. It does not request always:true or system-wide config modification. Persistent writes are limited to its own memory/ directory per the spec.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and only needs permission to read recent session messages and to create/append files under memory/. Before installing: (1) confirm you are comfortable with the agent persisting conversation content to memory/topics and decide whether any sensitive data might be saved; (2) review retention and access controls for the memory/ folder so other agents or users can't read stored memories; (3) consider whether the automatic end-of-conversation triggers match your language/use to avoid accidental saves; and (4) if you want tighter control, require manual /extract-memories invocation instead of automatic/heartbeat triggering.
